use_case: Use the request form during residential pool maintenance and chemistry record when the pool service record must identify pool and spa volume, equipment, sanitizer system, water features, cover, occupancy, gates, and service history. Complete the applicable handoff for post-treatment readings, equipment status, swimming restriction, customer alert, repair referral, and next-service target.
